_comment: Liquid Glass radii, logical px (docs/STANDARD.md). scripts/glass-bar.sh writes Blur My Shell's keys and the CSS from here. 'gap' is the padding between a surface's edge and its rows or cards; rows are rounded at radius - gap. A row is a capsule at most (half its height), so radius = min(row, height / 2) + gap.

menu._comment: shell menus: rows are about 28 px tall, so a row capsule rounds at 14 at most

app_menu._comment: GTK app menus: rows are 26 px tall, so a row capsule rounds at 13 at most

submenu._comment: quick settings submenus: rows are 32 px tall, a capsule at 16; the card matches a 64 px toggle's 32 px ends, so the gap is 16

calendar._comment: button: the height of the notification list's Clear button, a capsule (radius 20, as the cards) set the gap in from the corner, so 20 + 12 = 32

switcher._comment: Alt-Tab and the workspace switcher: items concentric, 28 - 8

osd._comment: volume and brightness HUD: a glass capsule

folder._comment: the app folder popup in the overview, as the calendar

search._comment: overview search result panels: the provider's capsule in the corner is 48 px tall (24 px ends) in a 12 px gap, so 36; the patch holds the same 36 for the glass. Rows are capsules too
